p.trouble.title: Troubleshooting
p.trouble.helperHint: Allow Soqo Island in your antivirus, then restart it
p.support.lead: Soqo Island is free and open source (GPL-3.0), with no ads and no tracking, and always will be.
p.support.starHint: Free, and it helps others find Soqo Island
p.support.openSourceHint: GPL-3.0 · notices and licences under Legal notices
p.islamic.title: Islamic Features
p.islamic.enableHint: Prayer times, reminders, du'a and Qur'an verses. Off for new installations; everything below applies only while this is on.
p.islamic.scenesHint: Soqi announces the adhan beside a card
p.islamic.sources: Qur'an text: Tanzil Project (tanzil.net), Uthmani text, copied unchanged under CC BY 3.0 and shown in the KFGQPC Hafs font (King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex). Prayer times are calculated on this PC with the PrayTimes method.
onboarding.title: Welcome to Soqo Island
onboarding.sub: Music, downloads, apps, a shelf for files and smart alerts live in this little island. Press Ctrl+Alt+I to open it, right-click for the menu. Optional features such as prayer times are under Settings › Features.
islamicPrompt.title: Keep prayer times and reminders?
islamicPrompt.sub: Your imported settings had them on. Keep them, or turn them off — you can change this any time under Settings › Features.
prayer.method.FRANCE: Union des Organisations Islamiques de France
prayer.method.RUSSIA: Spiritual Administration of Muslims of Russia
p.soqi.showHint: Off: the island works exactly the same, without the companion
p.privacy.dotsHint: Shows which app is using them; it does not block access
p.privacy.liveGlassHint: Captures the screen area under the island to blur it; the capture never leaves the app. Off: a plain dark pane and no capture
p.general.startWithWindowsHint: Starts quietly as the floating island when you sign in. Also listed under Windows Settings › Apps › Startup.
p.support.thirdPartyHint: KFGQPC Hafs font (King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex), Qur'an text by the Tanzil Project, Electron, node-ical, Open-Meteo, PrayTimes method
p.dl.idmHint: Live progress and control when the IDM download manager is installed
p.timer.sizeHint: The size of the countdown pill on the desktop. Over another app a running timer shrinks to a small pill at the same spot and grows back on the desktop. Medium and Large show pause and reset on hover.
p.timer.onTop: Keep a running timer visible in full screen
p.timer.onTopHint: The island always floats above other windows such as Chrome; with this on a running timer also stays while an app is full screen or maximized (with those hide options on)
p.soqi.clicksHint: A click on Soqi gets a playful reaction
soqi.aria: Soqi the Dolphin. Click to say hi
p.location.openMeteoHint: City search and forecasts come from Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0, free for non-commercial use)
p.general.hideMaximized: Hide while an app is maximized
p.general.hideMaximizedHint: Off by default. A running timer stays if "Keep a running timer visible in full screen" is on
p.legal.title: Legal notices
p.legal.hint: Soqo Island is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0. These are the notices shipped inside this copy of the application.
weather.popText: Forecasts and city search come from Open-Meteo.com, free for non-commercial use under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. City names are based on GeoNames.
act.enableHint: Turn on Coding Agents under Settings › Connections to see Claude Code and Codex sessions here.
act.noSessions: No sessions yet. Start Claude Code or Codex in a terminal and it shows up here.
act.recentHint: Alerts from coding agents and, if you turn them on in Settings › Connections, Windows notifications show up here.
act.question: Waiting for your answer
act.noTerminal: The terminal window could not be identified
p.agents.title: Coding Agents
p.agents.enable: Show coding agents on the island
p.agents.enableHint: Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions: working, waiting for your approval, finished or failed. Local only, through the agents' own hooks. Approvals are always given in the terminal, never here.
p.agents.notFound: Not found on this PC (install it, then connect)
p.agents.outdated: Connected to another installation path · Update
p.agents.expand: Open the island on an approval request
p.agents.expandHint: For the alert's duration, on the Activity tab; collapses again by itself
p.agents.inFocusHint: Approval requests also appear on the full-screen Focus Mode view
p.agents.hideDetailsHint: Show only the tool's name, never the command or the file
p.agents.note: Connect adds Soqo Island's entries to the agent's user-level hook file after asking you and keeps a backup next to it; Disconnect removes exactly those entries. Codex asks you to trust new hooks once with /hooks. Nothing is sent to any server.
p.notif.title: Windows notifications
p.notif.enable: Show Windows notifications on the island
p.notif.enableHint: The notifications Windows shows in its notification centre, including Chrome web notifications such as WhatsApp Web. Read through Windows' own notification listener; nothing is read from the apps themselves and nothing is stored.
p.notif.denied: Not allowed. Turn on "Let apps access notifications" in Windows Settings › Privacy & security › Notifications
p.notif.unavailable: Not available on this Windows version
p.notif.previewHint: Off: app and title only, never the message text
p.notif.note: Quiet while Windows is in do-not-disturb, during a focus session and while an app is full screen. Chrome has to deliver its notifications through Windows (its default). The island is never shown on the lock screen.
